lines.zh: 沙湾的水浅得发烫，我贴着凉泥游。
lines.en: The shallows of this sand bay are hot; I hug the cool mud.

lines.zh: 干季的水洼只剩半池，我慢慢巡一圈。
lines.en: The dry-season pool is half gone; I circle it slowly once.

lines.zh: 我从棕榈影里滑过，鳞片蹭出细响。
lines.en: I slide beneath palm shade, scales scraping a thin sound.

lines.zh: 热沙围着我这一小片水，我绕不开。
lines.en: Hot sand rings my little patch of water; I cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我摆尾掀浑泥，把藏身的鱼惊出来。
lines.en: My tail stirs the mud and flushes the fish in hiding.

lines.zh: 水面晒得发白，我下沉半尺避热。
lines.en: The surface glares white under sun, so I sink a foot.

lines.zh: 我沿着干裂的岸线走，找更深的地方。
lines.en: I trace the cracked shoreline, hunting for deeper ground.

lines.zh: 沙漠的河一年只满两次，我记得水位。
lines.en: The desert river fills twice a year; I remember the levels.

lines.zh: 我缓慢穿过芦苇根，鳍几乎不摆动。
lines.en: I drift through reed roots, fins barely moving at all.

lines.zh: 这条水道是我的，我沿岸来回压。
lines.en: This channel is mine; I press up and down its bank.

lines.zh: 草丛边的水带着土味，我张嘴滤一口。
lines.en: The grass-side water tastes of soil; I gulp a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑行，影子投在浅滩上。
lines.en: I glide along the sandy floor, shadow thrown on the shallows.

lines.zh: 干旱把我的池子缩成一条窄沟。
lines.en: Drought has shrunk my pool into a narrow ditch.

lines.zh: 我在这里等到黄昏，水温才降下来。
lines.en: I wait here until dusk, when the water finally cools.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙洲边缘慢慢绕。
lines.en: I work my way slowly around the edge of the sandbar.

lines.zh: 水面落下一片棕榈叶，我避开。
lines.en: A palm frond drops onto the water and I dodge it.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，看看天色。
lines.en: I put my head above the surface to check the sky.

lines.zh: 水浅得露背，我只好侧着游。
lines.en: The water is so shallow my back shows, so I swim on my side.

lines.zh: 我悬在浑水里不动，像一块旧木头。
lines.en: I hang motionless in the murk, like an old log.

lines.zh: 气泡从我鳃边冒出，一串比一串慢。
lines.en: Bubbles slip from my gills, each string slower than the last.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，试试水里的味道。
lines.en: I open my jaw and close it, tasting the water.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍竖着，像插在泥里的小帆。
lines.en: My dorsal fin stands up like a small sail in mud.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上骆驼铃，懒得抬头。
lines.en: Camel bells ring on the bank; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的水面烤出一层白雾。
lines.en: The sun bakes a white haze over my water.

lines.zh: 我在等一条比自己小的鱼靠近。
lines.en: I wait for a fish smaller than me to come near.

lines.zh: 这池水安静得能听见沙落下来。
lines.en: This pool is so quiet I hear sand settling.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，再慢慢收回。
lines.en: I stretch my jaw wide, then draw it slowly shut.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在混水下发着暗铜色。
lines.en: Under the muddy water my scales glow dull bronze.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水流过鳃缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 远处有蹄声踩过干裂的河床。
lines.en: Hooves clatter somewhere across the cracked riverbed.

lines.zh: 我悬着，等这一片水凉下来。
lines.en: I hang here, waiting for this patch of water to cool.

lines.zh: 没什么可做的，我数着水面波纹。
lines.en: Nothing to do; I count the ripples on the surface.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，影子落到我头上。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, your shadow falling over my head.

lines.zh: 我抬眼打量你，估你有多大。
lines.en: I lift my eye and measure how big you are.

lines.zh: 你在沙地上踩出脚印，我记住了。
lines.en: Your footprints press into the sand; I mark them.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，这水里你追不上我。
lines.en: I am not afraid; you cannot chase me in water.

lines.zh: 我半露背鳍，看你会不会伸手。
lines.en: I show half a fin, watching whether you reach in.

lines.zh: 你身上的水壶声，比脚步声清楚。
lines.en: Your water flask rattles louder than your steps.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的手，那里常藏着钩。
lines.en: I fix on your hands; hooks tend to hide there.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我反而往深处退了半尺。
lines.en: You crouch down, so I back a foot deeper.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，才慢慢转开眼睛。
lines.en: I watch you a long while before turning my eye away.

lines.zh: 你的影子一动，我的鳍就绷紧了。
lines.en: Your shadow shifts and my fins pull tight.

lines.zh: 你的叉扎进我的背，水立刻浑了。
lines.en: Your spear bites my back and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我疼得乱撞，把池底搅翻。
lines.en: Pain makes me thrash and churn the pool floor.

lines.zh: 伤口在侧腹，我懒得再藏。
lines.en: The wound is in my flank; I stop hiding.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉，经不起几刀。
lines.en: All this flesh of mine will not take many cuts.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像一团红沙。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water like red sand.

lines.zh: 我撞向石头，想甩开那阵痛。
lines.en: I ram a stone, trying to shake off the pain.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我的鳍边，我游歪了。
lines.en: You shear my fin edge and my swimming tilts.

lines.zh: 我躲进泥里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I burrow into the mud with only my eye out.

lines.zh: 疼从背脊一直传到尾巴。
lines.en: The pain runs from my spine right down to my tail.

lines.zh: 我沉到最深处，等你走开。
lines.en: I sink to the deepest part and wait for you to leave.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎饵沉下来，我绕了一圈。
lines.en: Your scattered bait sinks; I circle it once.

lines.zh: 那点腥味在水里拉出一条线。
lines.en: That bloody smell draws a line through the water.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，先看它会不会动。
lines.en: I do not bite yet; first I see if it moves.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在滴水，我靠近了。
lines.en: The thing in your hand drips, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我闻到了虫子的土腥味，忍不住。
lines.en: I catch the earthy smell of worms and cannot resist.

lines.zh: 饵落在沙上，我的嘴已经张开了。
lines.en: The bait lands on sand and my jaw is already open.

lines.zh: 我绕着那团食物转，先试一口水。
lines.en: I circle that morsel, tasting the water first.

lines.zh: 你抖了抖手，饵的味道更浓了。
lines.en: You shake your hand and the bait smells stronger.

lines.zh: 我贴近水面，眼睛只盯着那一点。
lines.en: I rise near the surface, eyes fixed on that one spot.

lines.zh: 明知道有钩，我还是忍不住靠近。
lines.en: I know there is a hook, and still I drift closer.

lines.zh: 你的腿撞进水里，我猛地一甩尾。
lines.en: Your leg splashes in and my tail whips hard.

lines.zh: 我蹭到你的靴子，鳞片刮出响声。
lines.en: I scrape your boot, scales rasping against the leather.

lines.zh: 池子太小，我们撞在一起了。
lines.en: The pool is too small; we have collided.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得偏了半尺，很不高兴。
lines.en: You knock me half a foot aside, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你踩乱了我的泥床，水全浑了。
lines.en: You trample my mud bed and the water turns thick.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞回去，让你知道分量。
lines.en: I ram you back so you learn my weight.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，我的鳍划到你。
lines.en: We brush past and my fin rakes your skin.

lines.zh: 水花溅上岸，我退到芦苇后面。
lines.en: Water sprays the bank; I retreat behind the reeds.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我贴着你绕过去。
lines.en: You block my way, so I slide around you.

lines.zh: 这一撞把沉泥都翻起来了。
lines.en: That collision turns the settled mud right over.

lines.zh: 雨季来了，我才有心思找同伴。
lines.en: Only when the rains come do I look for a mate.

lines.zh: 我拍打水面，让远处的同类听见。
lines.en: I slap the surface so my kind hear me from afar.

lines.zh: 她游过来时，我把背鳍全立起来。
lines.en: When she swims near, I raise my whole dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我们在浅滩上并行，尾巴一起摆。
lines.en: We run side by side over the shallows, tails in time.

lines.zh: 这片水够养一窝小鱼吗，我在算。
lines.en: I am reckoning whether this water can raise a brood.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭她的侧腹，很轻。
lines.en: I nudge her flank with my head, very gently.

lines.zh: 旱地里找伴侣，得先找水。
lines.en: To find a mate in dry land, first find water.

lines.zh: 两条大鱼在石边并排打转，水纹缠着。
lines.en: Two big fish circle the stone together, their ripples braided.

lines.zh: 她走了，我留在原地看水纹散开。
lines.en: She leaves; I stay and watch the ripples widen.

lines.zh: 卵要下在暖水里，我记得那块浅湾。
lines.en: The eggs need warm water; I remember that shallow bay.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶起一块石子，又吐掉。
lines.en: I nudge a pebble up, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 水上漂来的果核，我咬了咬。
lines.en: A fruit stone floats past; I give it a bite.

lines.zh: 我试着叼起那根草，它太轻了。
lines.en: I try to carry that reed; it is far too light.

lines.zh: 骨头沉到泥里，我用嘴翻出来。
lines.en: A bone sinks in the mud; I root it out with my jaw.

lines.zh: 我含住一块亮东西，觉得不好吃。
lines.en: I mouth something shiny and decide it tastes wrong.

lines.zh: 我把漂来的叶子拖到石头下面。
lines.en: I drag a floating leaf beneath my stone.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我牙间，我甩头吐掉。
lines.en: Something sticks between my teeth; I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我捡起沉底的碎壳，含着游一圈。
lines.en: I pick up a sunken shell and swim a lap with it.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币在水底发亮，我碰了碰。
lines.en: A coin glints on the bottom; I bump it once.

lines.zh: 我只会用嘴拿东西，拿不稳。
lines.en: I can only carry things in my jaw, and badly.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼闪了鳞，我盯住了它。
lines.en: A small fish flashes silver and I have it.

lines.zh: 水面有东西在扑腾，我转向那边。
lines.en: Something flutters at the surface; I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我看见了那条瘸腿的鱼，够慢。
lines.en: I spot the limping fish; it is slow enough.

lines.zh: 芦苇里有影子动，我把身体压低。
lines.en: A shadow stirs in the reeds and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 猎物离我两大口，我先不动。
lines.en: The prey is two mouthfuls away; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我锁定了水边那个低头的影子。
lines.en: I fix on the shape bending down at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 一条受伤的鱼在打转，就是它了。
lines.en: A wounded fish spins in circles; that one is mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体对准那点动静。
lines.en: I slowly line my body up with that small noise.

lines.zh: 鳃盖一张一合，我在算距离。
lines.en: My gill covers work while I reckon the distance.

lines.zh: 这小东西没发现我，正好。
lines.en: The little thing has not noticed me; good.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，不加速，只跟。
lines.en: I follow it without speeding up, only follow.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就往左，贴着泥。
lines.en: It goes left, so I go left, hugging the mud.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不动，身体在悄悄靠近。
lines.en: My eye stays fixed while my body creeps closer.

lines.zh: 它尾巴一甩，我的鼻尖便近一分。
lines.en: One flick of its tail and my snout gains a finger's width.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，水几乎不起波。
lines.en: I swing behind it, barely raising a ripple.

lines.zh: 我等着它游进那块浅沙。
lines.en: I wait for it to swim onto that shallow sand.

lines.zh: 它回头看了，我立刻停住。
lines.en: It glances back; I stop dead.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我不用再藏。
lines.en: Close enough now; I need not hide anymore.

lines.zh: 我的嘴慢慢张开，水从鳃出去。
lines.en: My jaw opens slowly, water leaving through my gills.

lines.zh: 它还在犹豫，我的耐心比它多。
lines.en: It still hesitates; I have more patience than it does.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它，整个吞下去。
lines.en: I snap it up and swallow the whole thing.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里倒钩，它挣不出去。
lines.en: My teeth hook inward; it cannot twist free.

lines.zh: 我在水里猛冲，把它撞翻。
lines.en: I lunge through the water and knock it over.

lines.zh: 大嘴张开的声音，比咬更吓人。
lines.en: The sound of my jaw opening frightens more than the bite.

lines.zh: 它被咬成两截，水立刻红了。
lines.en: It comes apart in two and the water reddens.

lines.zh: 我甩头撕扯，从石缝里拽出猎物。
lines.en: I shake my head and tear the prey from its crevice.

lines.zh: 这一咬用尽我全身的力。
lines.en: This bite uses every bit of strength I have.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我又补了一口。
lines.en: It is still moving, so I take another bite.

lines.zh: 我把猎物顶在泥上，慢慢吞。
lines.en: I pin the catch against the mud and swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 吞完之后，我退回深水歇着。
lines.en: When it is down, I withdraw to deep water to rest.

lines.zh: 我从干河床最后一片水里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise from the last water in a dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 沙暴刚过去，我的池子还是浑的。
lines.en: The sandstorm has passed; my pool is still cloudy.

lines.zh: 我在炎热的水里睁眼，先找阴影。
lines.en: I open my eyes in hot water and look for shade first.

lines.zh: 这片绿洲太小，却只有我一个。
lines.en: This oasis is small and holds only me.

lines.zh: 太阳把浅滩照透，我往下沉了沉。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the shallows; I sink a little lower.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇根间钻出来，鳍还沾泥。
lines.en: I slip out between reed roots, fins still muddy.

lines.zh: 水面漂着枯叶，说明雨季走了。
lines.en: Dead leaves float here; the rains have gone.

lines.zh: 我在这条沟里出生，又回到这里。
lines.en: I was born in this ditch, and I have come back.

lines.zh: 远处有鬣狗叫，我把背鳍压低。
lines.en: Hyenas call in the distance; I flatten my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在沙上，然后才是身体。
lines.en: My shadow lands on the sand before my body does.

lines.zh: 水被烤热，我贴着泥底不敢动。
lines.en: The water heats up and I press flat against the bottom.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，在热沙上拍打。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the bank, flapping on hot sand.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里却喘不上气，说不清。
lines.en: I am in water and still cannot breathe; strange.

lines.zh: 冲击把整池水推走，我搁浅了。
lines.en: The blast shoves the pool away and strands me.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，擦过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow strikes the water and grazes my back.

lines.zh: 光在水里亮起来，我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: Light blooms in the water and my scales prickle.

lines.zh: 池里没鱼了，我啃水草根。
lines.en: No fish left in the pool; I gnaw on reed roots.

lines.zh: 雷落进池子，我全身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the pool and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 水一下没了，下面空得像井。
lines.en: The water is gone; below is empty as a well.
